call_points.text: Overall QAAUM including alternate assets grew 42% YoY to ₹6,279 bn; MF QAAUM rose 6% to ₹4,277 bn.
Equity MF QAAUM rose 10% YoY to ₹1,987 bn; equity MF mix was 46.5%.
PMS/AIF QAAUM including the ESIC and EPFO mandate grew 5x YoY to ₹1,945 bn from ₹287 bn.
The ESIC/EPFO mandate QAAUM alone was ₹1,898 bn in Q1FY27.
Passive QAAUM was ₹400 bn, up 14% YoY.
Monthly SIP contribution was ₹10.85 bn for June 2026 with 4.03 mn contributing accounts.
Total equity rose to ₹43,776 mn at June 2026 from ₹40,416 mn at March 2026.
Board approved a final dividend of ₹25.50 per share for FY26, subject to shareholder approval.
Allotted 3,97,297 equity shares on ESOP exercise during the quarter.
Board approved a proposed dividend of ₹25.50 per share for FY26.
